reason: v14 accepted A-C but D exhausted four attempts with a too-large site and 1 m or zero-width frontage roads. One v14 D response becomes fully valid if the 1 m frontage expands by exactly 1 m toward the main street. This diagnostic adds opt-in candidate generation for roads narrower than 2 m (or zero thickness), accepting a change only after the entire original D validator passes. Sites, other geometry, user constraints and budgets remain v14-equivalent.
scope: One 0.1.0 fixed A-F single-storey building case. Road projection is bounded and journaled, not general semantic repair.
sample_policy: One run. All started calls count; v1-v14 remain intact. Later paid attempts require separate registration.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect one single-storey timber house, connected street-facing entry and reachable room. Exports do not prove target import or actual walking.
success.report: Record calls, normalizations, failures, elapsed time and provider usage. One pass is not general reliability evidence.
